title: VtM5e Equipment (Chicago)
description: Standalone weapons/armor/gear compendium for a modern-day Chicago Vampire the Masquerade 5e chronicle - named real-world firearms with brand variety, built on the V5 Homebrew Wiki's weapon tag system (Sharei Faedrawolf) and made functional via vtm5e-automation's weapon-tags.js. Neither the corebook nor the third-party vampire-the-masquerade-5e-compendium addon ship a real weapons catalog, so this is built from scratch rather than forked. Not published; built for personal use.
